Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the immediate next steps for procurement readiness: 

- Redwood team: Marissa (sales ops) + Dylan (account exec) + Neha (customer success)
- GreenLane procurement lead: Jordan Myers; Legal: Samantha (cc'd as needed)

Action items we discussed:
1) Vendor setup packet & tax forms: GreenLane to share W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) and any vendor onboarding docs you require.
2) Commercial path: confirm whether GreenLane prefers PO workflows (Net 30/60) vs charge card for initial purchase.
3) Vendor portal: if you have a vendor portal we can submit banking details there; otherwise we can accept DocuSign packet or secure transfer.
4) Marketplace interest: you mentioned potential interest in listing on the Cloud Marketplace — please flag if procurement requires additional MSA language or marketplace-specific terms.

Would you be able to share the vendor packet and W-9 today or tomorrow? If you prefer, we can also open a vendor intake ticket on your portal (please share the link).

Next meeting: optional follow-up with procurement/legal if you need redlines reviewed — we can have legal + our finance ops join.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the intake quickly so we can schedule a pilot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations
